modes.title: Keyboard Navigation & Visible Focus
modes.standard: WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 Success Criterion 2.4.7 (Focus Visible - Level AA)
modes.description: Interactive demonstration contrasting accessible 3px high-contrast focus rings and logical tab ordering against faulty 'outline: none' anti-patterns.

faultyDemo.focusTrap: Focus escapes behind backdrop into obscured background links

modes.title: Screen Reader Accessible Names & Transcripts
modes.standard: WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value - Level A)
modes.description: Text transcript demonstrating what NVDA and JAWS screen readers announce to blind users when interactive controls are properly coded versus unlabelled icons.
modes.accessibleAnnouncement: “Submit Payment, button. Press Enter to activate. Required payment amount: $180.00 NZD.”
modes.faultyAnnouncement: “Button. Unlabelled graphic.” (Leaves user completely unable to determine button function).

modes.title: Reflow & Responsive 400% Zoom
modes.description: Verification that content reflows into a single vertical column without two-dimensional scrolling at 400% zoom (320 CSS pixels wide).
modes.details: Zero horizontal scrollbars. Grid collapses into vertical single-column cards.

modes.title: Accessible Form Errors & Inline Associations
modes.description: Comparison between an accessible error summary box with in-page jump anchors and aria-describedby associations versus generic browser alerts.
modes.accessibleTreatment: Focus moves to Error Summary with role='alert'. Each error item is a clickable anchor linking to the invalid input.
modes.faultyTreatment: Vague red outline on input with no text explanation and no screen-reader announcement.

modes.title: Color Contrast Ratios & Graphical Objects
modes.description: Measured contrast ratios for body text (minimum 4.5:1), large headings (minimum 3:1), and UI components/icons (minimum 3:1).

measurements.element: Primary Heading on Dark Navy (#FFFFFF on #0B1F3A)
